name: Chholo
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.note: Unclassifiable, essentially unattested Bolivian languoid; no descriptive source located

sources.citation: DOBES Uru-Chipaya project pages (Böcker, Condori Mollo & Schumacher), dobes.mpi.nl/projects/uru-chipaya/
sources.note: Phonology paragraph concerns Chipaya only; the Uru-Muratos of Lake Poopó are named as a variety to be documented 'where possible' but nothing linguistic is given for it.

sources.citation: Fabre, Alain. 2005-. Diccionario etnolingüístico y guía bibliográfica de los pueblos indígenas sudamericanos: Uru-Chipaya (8 pp.).
sources.note: Nothing on stress; gives 'chholo' as the Murato autodenomination and a bibliography including López García 2010 'Huella de las lenguas cholo y pukina de los urus del lago Poopó' (RAE XXIII: 647-654, MUSEF), Miranda Mamani et al. 1992 'Memorias de un olvido', Schumacher et al. 2008/2009.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid page + md.ini for chho1235 (Hammarström et al.)
sources.note: Nothing; lists five sources (Ibarra 1962 ethnography, Montaño Aragón 1972 numerals, 'Garcis: Cholo' = López García 2010, Schumacher et al. 2009 'minimal', Miranda et al. 1992 testimonies); MEDs all 'wordlist_or_less'; altnames Capillu, Cholo, Uru-Moratos, Uru-Muratos; links to Wikipedia 'Murato language'.
Nothing on stress or phonology; lists a few remembered words and suffixes from Schumacher et al. 2009 p.117 and classifies the language tentatively as Uru-Chipaya.

sources.citation: Hannß, Katja. 2024. Uru and Chipaya. In The Oxford Guide to the Languages of the Central Andes, 265-310. Oxford: OUP.
